essence: The yoginīs manifest in diverse animal forms, including fierce and common creatures.
Having assumed various forms, the yoginīs sport freely upon the earth.
Despite the incomplete description, one must attentively ascertain that form.
The yoginīs may also appear as scorpions, snakes, mice, and frogs.
The manifestations include dangers such as disease, kings, and thieves.
